Dear Sir/ Madam,  
  
Sub: Audio recording of the Analyst and Investor Earning Conference Call. 
 
In furtherance of our intimations dated July 21, 2026 and August 3, 2026 giving intimation for the Q1 & FY27  
earning Conference Call for the analysts and investors and pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46(2)(oa) of the  
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the audio 
recording of the Investor and Analyst Conference Call on the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the 
quarter ended June 30, 2026 held today i.e Tuesday, August 4, 2026, is available on the website of the Company 
and can be accessed through the following link: 
 
https://resources.thomascook.in/downloads/Audiomp3/Earnings_Call_Q1FY27.mp3 
 
 
 
This is for your information and records.  
 
Thank you.  
   
Yours faithfully, 
For Thomas Cook (India) Limited 
 
 
 
 
Amit J. Parekh 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer  
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
AMIT 
JYOTINDRA 
PAREKH
